title: Chapter 9: The Mother-Grove Amphitheater & The Unburied Leitmotif (Stardate 49603.5)
summary: Following the converging crimson-and-cyan mycelial veins inland during Ring-Night, the family discovers a natural tiered basalt canyon amphitheater ringed by 100-foot crystal fronds—where Cassidy plays her cherished 1985 Progress Street chorus call-and-response and the entire living planet echoes her synthesizer leitmotif back at stadium volume.
